extracted.name: Grandma's Yorkshire Pudding
extracted.description: These are delicious Yorkies! Very easy, too! Serve Yorkshire pudding with roast beef or pork, as this recipe requires meat drippings.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (220 degrees C). Place about a tablespoon of beef drippings into each cup of a 6-cup muffin tin.
Whisk eggs in a medium bowl until well-blended. Stir in milk, flour, and salt. Fill the muffin cups about halfway.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
